tools.name: viraloop_get_ad_discovery_capabilities
tools.description: Get ad discovery availability. Returns discovery and advertiser-search availability and saved-ad limits, without exposing Meta credentials. Saved references remain usable when discovery is paused.

workspaceId.description: Brand workspace; defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_search_meta_ads
tools.description: Search Meta ads delivered in the EU and UK. Searches the official Meta Ad Library by ad keywords or exact advertiser Page ID. Returns up to 25 ads, a resultToken for saving, its expiresAt deadline, and an opaque nextCursor. Cached repeats retain the original expiry and do not consume the team's discovery allowance. Ads have copy and public Meta preview links, not direct media files. No generation credits are charged.

workspaceId.description: Brand workspace; defaults to the team's default workspace.

q.description: Ad text keywords. Supply q or pageId, not both.

pageId.description: Exact Facebook advertiser Page ID; no name matching.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from this search. Keep filters unchanged.

tools.name: viraloop_get_ad_creative_preview
tools.description: Get a competitor ad's creative preview. Returns available image/video URLs from an isolated rendering of Meta's public Ad Library page. Requires an unexpired resultToken or an owned savedId and matching adId. Independently feature-gated, cached and capped; no generation credits. Media may be unavailable or expire. This uses Meta webpage rendering, not additional Graph API media fields. Never returns snapshot URLs or operator credentials.

workspaceId.description: Brand workspace; defaults to the team's default workspace.

resultToken.description: Unexpired search receipt containing this ad; supply this or savedId.

savedId.description: Owned saved reference in the selected workspace; supply this or resultToken.

refresh.description: Refresh expired/broken media. Fresh cache entries have a 60-second refresh cooldown.

tools.name: viraloop_search_ad_advertisers
tools.description: Find advertiser Page IDs by name. Uses separately approved Meta Pages Search access. Select a returned Page ID and call searchMetaAds. If unavailable, use keyword search or a Page ID from an Ad Library advertiser link.

workspaceId.description: Brand workspace; defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_list_saved_ads
tools.description: List saved competitor ads. Lists the workspace's saved ad references, newest saved first. Optionally filter by advertiser Page ID. Includes last-observed metadata and source links even after a Meta source disappears.

workspaceId.description: Brand workspace; defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_save_ad
tools.description: Save a competitor ad reference. Saves server-held metadata from an unexpired search result into the brand workspace. Supply the adId and resultToken from searchMetaAds. Saving the same ad again is idempotent; client-supplied ad metadata is rejected.

workspaceId.description: Brand workspace; defaults to the team's default workspace.

resultToken.description: resultToken from the search page containing this ad.

tools.name: viraloop_delete_saved_ad
tools.description: Remove a saved ad reference. Removes a saved reference from the selected workspace. Does not delete generated content or modify the source advertisement. Repeating a deletion succeeds.

workspaceId.description: Brand workspace; defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_ad_recreation
tools.description: Start a brand ad adaptation draft. Creates a workspace-owned draft from a server-validated search receipt or saved ad, or forks a generated adaptation. Retains source metadata without Meta media URLs. Preparing a draft costs no generation credits. Reuse requestId on retries. Set the format, use generateAdRecreationBrief and review the editable brief/script. For images call createMetaAdCreative with recreationId, recreationRevision and requestId. For videos call createAdRecreationVideo with id, revision and requestId.

workspaceId.description: Brand workspace; explicit IDs must belong to your team.

requestId.description: Unique creation request ID. Reuse on a network retry to reopen the same draft.

contentId.description: Fork an owned previously generated adaptation instead of supplying an ad reference.

tools.name: viraloop_get_ad_recreation
tools.description: Get an ad adaptation draft. Returns the owned draft, its source snapshot, settings, language, revision, and most recently generated content ID. It remains available after the search receipt or Meta source expires.

workspaceId.description: Brand workspace; explicit IDs must belong to your team.

tools.name: viraloop_update_ad_recreation
tools.description: Save an edited image or video adaptation brief. Saves image or video settings using the last observed revision; stale edits return 409. Set settings.format to image, talking-head, or hook-demo. Video settings include an editable script, timed scenes, presenter/product images and workspace-owned uploaded video asset IDs. Meta preview URLs are rejected. Source provenance cannot be edited. No generation credits.

workspaceId.description: Brand workspace; explicit IDs must belong to your team.

tools.name: viraloop_generate_ad_recreation_brief
tools.description: Draft original ad copy and direction for your brand. Uses brand facts, tone, design guidelines, language, and competitor copy to draft an editable brief. Video drafts also receive a script and timed scene outline. Visual analysis uses only a supplied image or one preview frame of an owned uploaded reference video; it does not infer video motion or dialogue. Checks revision before saving; concurrent edits are preserved. No generation credits. Review before generating.

workspaceId.description: Brand workspace; explicit IDs must belong to your team.

tools.name: viraloop_create_ad_recreation_video
tools.description: Create a video from a reviewed brand adaptation. Resolves the owned draft and exact revision, validates claims and language, and reuses its saved assets. Talking Head UGC generates a 9:16 video from the script and supplied presenter (4-15 seconds, 5 credits/second). Hook & Demo assembles two owned uploaded clips into an editable Content deck without generation credits; the script guides the user's recording, and no speech or footage is synthesized. Both retain source/brief provenance and use existing library/export paths. Retrying the same requestId returns the same Content without another debit. Failed paid generations refund once. Poll GET /content/{id}; open /content?contentId=ID to edit and export.

workspaceId.description: Brand workspace; explicit IDs must belong to your team.

requestId.description: Keep this ID on retries, including after reload. A new ID requests a new output.

tools.name: viraloop_get_me
tools.description: Introspect the API key. Returns the team behind the credentials: name, credit balance, plan, default workspace and the scopes granted to the key. Call this first to verify auth works.

tools.name: viraloop_get_credits
tools.description: Credit balance and ledger. Returns the team's current credit balance plus a paginated ledger of credit movements (top-ups, spending, rewards, refunds). Turbo content generation does not consume credits; influencer media generation does (createInfluencerVideo: 5 credits per second of video, createInfluencer preview: 10). Failed generations are refunded automatically; running out of credits returns HTTP 402 with error type insufficient_credits.

tools.name: viraloop_list_workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces. Lists the team's workspaces (brands). Most endpoints accept an optional workspaceId and default to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_workspace
tools.description: Create a workspace. Creates a workspace (brand) under the team. Provide the brand's website and the brand profile (identity, positioning, content angles) is generated in the background: poll getWorkspace until brandContext.status is ready. One domain can be claimed by only one workspace across all of Viraloop.

websiteUrl.description: The brand's website; seeds the auto-generated brand profile

tools.name: viraloop_list_accounts
tools.description: List connected social accounts. Lists the TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook accounts connected to the workspace. Use the returned ids in selectedAccounts when creating posts. Connecting accounts (OAuth) happens in the web app, not through this API.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_generate_content
tools.description: Generate AI post suggestions. Generates a batch of ready-to-post content suggestions (video decks with captions, hashtags and rationale) using the workspace's brand context and Turbo configuration. Pass prompt to set the subject, and format to pick wall of text, slideshow or green screen meme. Synchronous: the request returns when generation finishes, typically 5 to 60 seconds depending on count. Review the results, then publish the ones you like via POST /posts with suggestionId.

format.description: Force one content format. Omit to use the workspace's configured mix.

prompt.description: What the batch should be about, e.g. 'why founders burn out on content'. Omit to let Turbo pick from the workspace's content angles.

influencerId.description: Feature this AI influencer in every suggestion

slideCount.description: Exact slides per slideshow (3-10). Omit to let the model pick 4-10.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_list_generations
tools.description: List suggestions. Lists generated content suggestions in the workspace queue (automation-owned suggestions are excluded). Filter by status: pending (awaiting review), accepted, scheduled.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_get_generation
tools.description: Get a suggestion. Returns one suggestion including its full deck (the editable render blueprint), influencer, angle, rationale and remix source. The deck IS the free preview: render its slide images / clips with the caption text boxes overlaid client-side to let a user accept or skip. Previewing and accepting are free; billing only happens when media is downloaded or published.

tools.name: viraloop_accept_generation
tools.description: Accept a generation into the library. Accepts a generated suggestion and saves it to the content library, returning a contentId. That id is what GET /content/{id}/download (fetch the media files) and POST /posts (publish) operate on. Idempotent: re-accepting returns the same contentId. Counts toward the plan's monthly content allowance.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_post
tools.description: Create and schedule a post. Schedules a post to one or more connected accounts. Four content sources, checked in order: suggestionId (publish a generated suggestion), contentId (publish a saved studio video from any /content operation), deck + format (publish a raw deck), or videoUrl / images (publish your own media). Deck-based posts are rendered server-side after this call returns; the response is 202 with a statusUrl to poll. schedule asap posts as soon as the render is ready; schedule scheduled requires a future scheduledTime. Supports the Idempotency-Key header.

contentId.description: Publish a saved studio video (from any /content operation). Finished videos post as-is; deck formats render first.

deck.description: Raw deck object (advanced; usually use suggestionId or contentId)

format.description: Deck format, required when deck is provided

videoUrl.description: Publicly reachable video URL to post as-is

images.description: Image URLs to post as an image/slideshow post

selectedAccounts.description: Social account ids per platform (from GET /accounts). At least one non-empty platform array is required.

scheduledTime.description: Required when schedule is scheduled; must be in the future

caption.description: Post caption/description. Defaults to the suggestion's.

tiktokSendToInbox.description: Send to TikTok inbox as draft instead of publishing

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_list_posts
tools.description: List posts. Lists the workspace's posts with optional status, automation and scheduled-time filters.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_get_post
tools.description: Get a post with per-platform results. Returns one post including render state and per-platform posting results (status, post URL, analytics snapshot). Poll this after creating a post: terminal statuses are posted, partial, completed and failed; renderStatus failed is also terminal.

tools.name: viraloop_cancel_post
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled post. Cancels a post that has not been published yet (status scheduled). Published or in-flight posts cannot be cancelled; that returns 409.

tools.name: viraloop_create_automation
tools.description: Create an automation. Creates a draft automation: a batch of AI posts generated at once and published on a schedule. Set name, cadence, selectedAccounts and settings here or later via PATCH, then call generate, review the posts, and launch. Monthly automation quota depends on the plan. With kind "ugc" it is a guided UGC campaign instead: set `ugc` (brief, characterId, voiceId, format), then draft scripts, prepare and render the variants you approve, and download or launch them.

kind.description: "standard" batch automation (default) or a guided "ugc" campaign

brief.description: What the videos sell; every script is grounded in it

format.description: talking: speaks to camera. spokesperson: holds the product (needs productImage + a compose step)

characterId.description: The influencer that fronts every video (import your own via POST /influencers)

voiceId.description: ElevenLabs voice id from GET /tts/voices; required before preparing variants

durationTarget.description: Script length target in seconds (15 or 30). The video is as long as the speech, capped at 30s

variantCount.description: How many script variants to draft (default 3)

productImage.description: Product photo or app screenshot for the spokesperson format

look.description: studio (default): one continuous take with no cuts (Seedance 2.5, re-voiced with the campaign voice), the most lifelike, 14 credits per second of speech. portrait: the still animated to the voice in jump-cut beats, 3 credits per second

selfie.description: talking format: animate a phone-selfie version of the character (make it with POST /automations/{id}/ugc/compose) instead of the portrait as-is

startDate.description: First posting day; defaults to tomorrow

cadence.description: Posting cadence: how many posts per day, for how many days

selectedAccounts.description: Social account ids per platform (from GET /accounts). At least one non-empty platform array is required.

contentMix.description: Format weights, keys: walloftext, slideshow, greenscreen, hookdemo

language.description: Content language for this automation; empty follows the workspace preference

slideshowVideo.description: Render slideshows as one video instead of an image carousel

slideCount.description: Exact slides per generated slideshow (3-10). null or omitted lets the model pick 4-10.

settings.description: Generation settings (defaults are sensible; all optional)

tiktokMode.description: TikTok publish mode; inbox sends drafts to the inbox

autoAddMusic.description: Let TikTok pick a song. Image carousels only

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_list_automations
tools.description: List automations. Lists the workspace's automations plus the monthly quota (limit, used, remaining).

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_get_automation
tools.description: Get an automation. Returns one automation with its live generatedCount. Poll this after calling generate: the automation leaves the generating status when done (review on success).

tools.name: viraloop_generate_automation
tools.description: Generate the automation's posts. Generates cadence.postsPerDay x cadence.lengthDays AI posts for the automation, each assigned a schedule slot. Asynchronous: returns 202 immediately; poll the automation until it reaches review (success) or back to draft (nothing generated). Calling it again while generating is a no-op that reports progress. Regenerating an automation in review replaces its posts.

tools.name: viraloop_extend_automation
tools.description: Extend an automation by more days. Adds `days` more days to an active or completed automation: generates cadence.postsPerDay x days new posts, schedules them in the days after the current window and publishes them to the automation's accounts. Posts already scheduled or published are never touched. Extending a completed automation revives it to active. Asynchronous: returns 202 immediately; the automation carries extending=true until the new posts land, so poll GET /automations/{id} until it flips false.

days.description: How many days to add to the automation window

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_launch_automation
tools.description: Launch a reviewed automation. Converts every generated post into a scheduled post at its slot and activates the automation. Requires status review and at least one selected account. Posts render server-side after this returns and publish automatically at their slots.

tools.name: viraloop_cancel_automation
tools.description: Cancel an automation. Cancels the automation and removes its unsent posts. Content that already went out stays live. Idempotent: cancelling a cancelled or completed automation returns cancelledPosts 0.

tools.name: viraloop_list_automation_posts
tools.description: List an automation's generated posts. Lists the automation's generated posts (suggestions) in schedule order, for review before launching. Each carries caption, postCaption, hashtags, rationale and its assigned scheduledTime. UGC campaign variants add script, hook, approved, the prepared quote (durationSeconds, credits) and the video state (idle, queued, processing, ready, failed) with its contentId.

tools.name: viraloop_update_automation_post
tools.description: Edit one of an automation's posts. Edits a generated post: postCaption, hashtags, scheduledTime and, for UGC campaign variants, script and approved. A script edit invalidates the variant's quote and approval and unlinks a video rendered from the old words (that video stays in the library). Only approved, finished variants with a future scheduledTime are launched.

tools.name: viraloop_generate_ugc_scripts
tools.description: Draft a UGC campaign's scripts. Drafts the campaign's script variants from its brief (hook -> problem -> benefit -> CTA, each with a different hook), replacing unrendered variants; with variantId it re-rolls that one script in place. Free. Needs ugc.characterId. Review or edit the scripts (PATCH the post), then prepare and render.

tools.name: viraloop_prepare_ugc_variants
tools.description: Prepare and price UGC variants. Synthesizes each variant's speech with the campaign voice, measures the real duration and quotes the render in credits. Free. A variant whose speech exceeds 30 seconds gets tooLong and no quote: shorten its script and prepare again. Quotes are bound to the current script, voice, format, still and look; any change invalidates them.

tools.name: viraloop_compose_ugc_still
tools.description: Compose the UGC campaign still. Makes the one image every variant is animated from. Spokesperson campaigns: the character holding ugc.productImage (required before preparing). Talking campaigns with ugc.selfie true: the character re-staged as a front-camera phone selfie in a real room, which reads far more like filmed UGC than a posed portrait. Charged once per call, refunded on failure; the new still invalidates existing quotes, so prepare again afterwards. Synchronous, typically 20 to 60 seconds.

tools.name: viraloop_render_ugc_variants
tools.description: Render UGC variants. Charges each variant's quote once and starts its video (two at a time per call; the prepared speech is reused). Fails before charging anything when credits are short or a quote is stale. Poll GET /automations/{id}/posts until video.status is ready or failed; a failed render is refunded once and can be rendered again. Download a finished video with GET /content/{contentId}/download.

tools.name: viraloop_list_influencers
tools.description: List AI influencers. Lists the workspace's AI influencers (virtual personas used to front content).

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_influencer
tools.description: Create an AI influencer. Creates an influencer from a base image you provide (a publicly reachable JPG, PNG or WebP URL; it is re-hosted as a provider-safe JPEG/PNG). A short animated preview is generated in the background when the team has credits, unless generatePreview is false. To generate a base image from a prompt instead, use the web app. Set style to "character" for a non-human influencer (a mascot, cartoon or stick figure): every prompt the platform builds for it then describes a stylized character instead of a real person, and gender/age/ethnicity do not apply.

imageUrl.description: Publicly reachable base image of the persona

niche.description: One of the app's niche slugs, e.g. fitness, tech, food

style.description: Visual style. "realistic" (default) is a photoreal human; "character" is a stylized non-human persona.

characterDescription.description: For style "character": what the character looks like, including its art style. Used to keep later generations on-model.

generatePreview.description: Set false to skip the paid animated preview and only import the still (default true).

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_video
tools.description: Generate a talking-head video. Generates a talking-head UGC video of the influencer speaking your script (Seedance 2, 9:16). Costs 5 credits per second of video (default 10s = 50 credits), deducted up front and refunded automatically if generation fails. Insufficient credits returns HTTP 402 (insufficient_credits). Asynchronous: returns 202 with the video in processing; poll GET /videos/{videoId} until completed or failed (typically 2 to 10 minutes).

imageUrl.description: Reference image; defaults to the influencer's base image

mode.description: speaker: talking head; scene: wider shot

tools.name: viraloop_get_video
tools.description: Get a video's status. Returns one generated video. Poll this after creating a video: terminal statuses are completed (videoUrl set) and failed (error set). A completed video can be posted via POST /posts with videoUrl.

tools.name: viraloop_list_assets
tools.description: List media assets. Lists the workspace's uploaded media library (videos and images used as generation backgrounds and sources). Uploading happens in the web app in v1.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_upload_asset
tools.description: Upload media into the workspace. Ingests a publicly reachable file into the workspace's media bank and returns a stable hosted asset. Use this to get a source video, a character photo or an app screenshot into Viraloop before generating a studio format that needs one. The source URL is fetched server-side, so it must be publicly readable (no auth headers, no signed-cookie hosts) and stay up until the request returns. Synchronous.

url.description: Publicly reachable https URL of the file to ingest

kind.description: video, image or audio. Inferred from the response content-type when omitted.

name.description: Display name in the media bank

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_character_swap
tools.description: Swap the character in a video. Replaces the person in a source clip with your character, driven by the clip's motion (Kling motion control, 9:16). Both media URLs must be hosted; upload them with POST /assets first. Costs 2 credits per second of source video, plus 3 credits when scene is 'recreate' (an extra image edit that composites your character into the clip's opening frame). Credits are deducted up front and refunded automatically if generation fails; insufficient credits returns HTTP 402. Asynchronous: returns 202, then poll GET /content/{id} until ready or failed (typically 3 to 20 minutes).

videoUrl.description: Hosted source clip, 3-30 seconds. Its length sets the output length and price.

characterImageUrl.description: Hosted photo of the character to swap in; should clearly show one face

scene.description: image (default): keep the character photo's own background, borrow only the clip's motion. recreate: composite the character into the clip's first frame instead, keeping the clip's scene but a still background.

keepSourceAudio.description: Lay the clip's original audio over the result. Default true.

influencerId.description: Link the result to this influencer's gallery

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_green_screen_mobile
tools.description: Generate a presenter holding your app. Generates a UGC video of a presenter holding a phone with your app on screen, speaking your script (9:16). Runs two steps server-side: one image edit puts the phone in the presenter's hand, then Seedance animates it. Both media URLs must be hosted; upload them with POST /assets first. Costs 3 credits for the composite plus 5 credits per second of video (default 8s = 43 credits), deducted up front and refunded automatically on failure; insufficient credits returns HTTP 402. Asynchronous: returns 202, then poll GET /content/{id} until ready or failed (typically 2 to 10 minutes).

appScreenshot.description: Hosted screenshot of your app; it is composited onto the phone screen as-is

presenterImage.description: Hosted photo of the presenter; should clearly show their face

script.description: What the presenter says about your app (max 1000 chars)

scene.description: Optional setting and outfit: where the presenter is and what they wear, e.g. 'sunny kitchen, beige knit sweater'

voiceId.description: ElevenLabs voice id, optionally prefixed with the model ('eleven_v3:<id>' for Eleven v3, 70+ languages; a bare id runs on multilingual v2). When set, the script is spoken word for word by that voice and lip-synced (Kling AI Avatar) instead of the video model improvising the voice; captions then match the script exactly. Recommended for non-English scripts. Omit to keep the video model's own voice.

duration.description: Seconds, default 8. Only used without voiceId (4-15). With voiceId the clip is as long as the spoken script (max 30s) and is priced per measured second of speech.

captionOverlay.description: Transcribe the speech into a styled caption track. Default true.

influencerId.description: Link the result to this influencer

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_clone_video
tools.description: Clone a video's motion onto your character. Drives your character with the motion of a reference clip (Kling motion control, 9:16). Unlike character swap this keeps your character's own scene throughout; it borrows only the movement. Both media URLs must be hosted; upload them with POST /assets first. Costs 2 credits per second of reference video, deducted up front and refunded automatically on failure; insufficient credits returns HTTP 402. Asynchronous: returns 202, then poll GET /content/{id} until ready or failed (typically 3 to 20 minutes).

imageUrl.description: Hosted photo of the character to animate

videoUrl.description: Hosted reference clip whose motion is copied. Its length sets the price.

videoDuration.description: Reference clip length in seconds. Probed from the file when omitted.

influencerId.description: Also save the result to this influencer's gallery

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_talking_head
tools.description: Generate a talking-head UGC video. Generates a UGC video of a person speaking your script to camera (Seedance, 9:16, with voice). Describe the person with gender/age/ethnicity/appearance, or pin their exact likeness with avatarImageUrl (a hosted photo; upload one with POST /assets). Costs 5 credits per second (default 10s = 50 credits), deducted up front and refunded automatically on failure; insufficient credits returns HTTP 402. Asynchronous: returns 202, then poll GET /content/{id} until ready or failed (typically 2 to 10 minutes).

avatarImageUrl.description: Hosted photo pinning the speaker's likeness. Overrides the persona fields.

duration.description: Seconds, default 10. Only used without voiceId (4-15). With voiceId the clip is as long as the spoken script (max 30s) and is priced per measured second of speech.

mode.description: speaker (default): head-and-shoulders to camera. scene: a wider shot.

gender.description: Persona hint, ignored when avatarImageUrl is set

age.description: Persona hint, ignored when avatarImageUrl is set

ethnicity.description: Persona hint, ignored when avatarImageUrl is set

appearance.description: Scene: setting and outfit, e.g. 'sunny kitchen, beige knit sweater'. With avatarImageUrl the face stays the reference's.

voiceId.description: ElevenLabs voice id, optionally prefixed with the model ('eleven_v3:<id>' for Eleven v3, 70+ languages; a bare id runs on multilingual v2). When set, the script is spoken word for word by that voice and lip-synced (Kling AI Avatar) instead of the video model improvising the voice; captions then match the script exactly. Recommended for non-English scripts. Omit to keep the video model's own voice.

captionOverlay.description: Transcribe the speech into a styled caption track. Default true.

influencerId.description: Link the result to this influencer

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_talking_head_green_screen
tools.description: Generate a presenter over your demo video. Generates a presenter speaking your script on a green screen, then composites them into the corner of your demo video at render time (9:16). Both media URLs must be hosted; upload them with POST /assets first. Costs 5 credits per second (default 10s = 50 credits), deducted up front and refunded automatically on failure; insufficient credits returns HTTP 402. Asynchronous: returns 202, then poll GET /content/{id} until ready or failed (typically 2 to 15 minutes).

demoThumb.description: Poster image for the demo video

avatarPosition.description: Which corner the presenter sits in. Default bottom-right.

scene.description: Optional outfit and look, e.g. 'navy blazer, glasses'. The background is always keyed out for the demo video.

voiceId.description: ElevenLabs voice id, optionally prefixed with the model ('eleven_v3:<id>' for Eleven v3, 70+ languages; a bare id runs on multilingual v2). When set, the script is spoken word for word by that voice and lip-synced (Kling AI Avatar) instead of the video model improvising the voice; captions then match the script exactly. Recommended for non-English scripts. Omit to keep the video model's own voice.

duration.description: Seconds, default 10. Only used without voiceId (4-15). With voiceId the clip is as long as the spoken script (max 30s) and is priced per measured second of speech.

captionOverlay.description: Transcribe the speech into a styled caption track. Default false.

influencerId.description: Link the result to this influencer

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_meta_ad
tools.description: Generate a static Meta ad creative. Creates one finished JPG ad for Facebook or Instagram from workspace brand context: product hero, bold headline, supporting copy and CTA. Supports square (1:1), portrait feed (4:5) and story (9:16), with cinematic, minimal or bold styling. Optionally supply a product screenshot and exact copy. Follows the workspace's content language and generation rules. Costs 3 image credits, deducted up front and refunded on failure. Returns 202; poll GET /content/{id} until ready or failed, then GET /content/{id}/download for the original image. The saved brief reopens in the Meta Ad Creatives studio. Creates artwork only; does not launch a paid campaign. Generating from an ad adaptation draft (recreationId) also requires the ads:read scope.

prompt.description: Campaign brief, offer, audience, or creative direction. Defaults to workspace brand context.

ratio.description: Square, portrait feed, or story aspect ratio

template.description: Ad layout: product hero, before/after split, us-vs-them comparison, customer review, feature callouts, promo offer, pain point, how it works (3 steps), notes app, or UGC photo. review and promo-offer require headline (the real quote or offer).

productImageUrl.description: Product photo or app screenshot to feature, uploaded with POST /assets

headline.description: Exact on-image headline. Omit to let AI write it.

supportingText.description: Exact supporting copy. Omit to let AI write it.

ctaText.description: Exact button text. Omit for an on-brand call to action.

accentColor.description: Headline and CTA accent color. Omit to use brand design guidelines.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

recreationId.description: Owned brand adaptation draft. Its saved settings override creative fields.

recreationRevision.description: The reviewed draft revision; required with recreationId.

requestId.description: Required with recreationId. Reuse on retries to avoid duplicate charges.

tools.name: viraloop_create_interview
tools.description: Generate an interview (podcast clip) video. Generates a cinematic podcast-clip video: an AI guest in a studio interview setting (broadcast mic, moody lighting) speaking your script as a candid answer (Seedance, 9:16, with voice). Describe the person with gender/age/ethnicity/appearance, or pin their exact likeness with avatarImageUrl (a hosted photo; upload one with POST /assets). Costs 5 credits per second (default 10s = 50 credits), deducted up front and refunded automatically on failure; insufficient credits returns HTTP 402. Asynchronous: returns 202, then poll GET /content/{id} until ready or failed (typically 2 to 10 minutes).

script.description: What the guest says, written as a candid answer (max 1000 chars)

avatarImageUrl.description: Hosted photo pinning the guest's likeness. Overrides the persona fields.

gender.description: Persona hint, ignored when avatarImageUrl is set

age.description: Persona hint, ignored when avatarImageUrl is set

ethnicity.description: Persona hint, ignored when avatarImageUrl is set

appearance.description: Scene: setting and outfit, e.g. 'sunny kitchen, beige knit sweater'. With avatarImageUrl the face stays the reference's.

captionOverlay.description: Transcribe the speech into a styled caption track. Default true.

influencerId.description: Link the result to this influencer

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_product_spokesperson
tools.description: Generate a spokesperson holding your product. Generates a UGC video of a person holding your product and talking about it (Seedance, 9:16, with voice). Give either spokespersonImage (a shot of someone already holding it) or avatarImage plus productImage, which are composed into one first. All media URLs must be hosted; upload them with POST /assets first. Costs 5 credits per second (default 8s = 40 credits) plus 3 credits when we compose the shot, deducted up front and refunded automatically on failure; insufficient credits returns HTTP 402. Asynchronous: returns 202, then poll GET /content/{id} until ready or failed (typically 2 to 10 minutes).

spokespersonImage.description: Hosted photo of a person already holding the product

avatarImage.description: Hosted photo of the person, composed with productImage

productImage.description: Hosted photo of the product, composed with avatarImage

instruction.description: Extra direction for the composed shot, e.g. 'outdoors, morning light'

scene.description: Optional setting and outfit: where the spokesperson is and what they wear

voiceId.description: ElevenLabs voice id, optionally prefixed with the model ('eleven_v3:<id>' for Eleven v3, 70+ languages; a bare id runs on multilingual v2). When set, the script is spoken word for word by that voice and lip-synced (Kling AI Avatar) instead of the video model improvising the voice; captions then match the script exactly. Recommended for non-English scripts. Omit to keep the video model's own voice.

duration.description: Seconds, default 8. Only used without voiceId (4-15). With voiceId the clip is as long as the spoken script (max 30s) and is priced per measured second of speech.

captionOverlay.description: Transcribe the speech into a styled caption track. Default true.

influencerId.description: Link the result to this influencer

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_grid_video
tools.description: Create a 2x2 grid video. Writes a listicle heading plus four labelled cells from your brand and prompt, finds a stock photo for each cell, and saves the result to your library (9:16). Costs no credits. Synchronous: the request returns when the deck is built, typically 10 to 40 seconds. Publish it with POST /posts using the deck from GET /content/{id}, or open it in the studio to edit first.

prompt.description: What the grid is about. Omit to let the model pick from your brand.

mentionBusiness.description: Make one of the four cells your brand. Default true.

portrait.description: Use portrait cell photos instead of landscape. Default false.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_listicle
tools.description: Create a listicle video. Writes a numbered-list title plus 4 to 6 items from your brand and prompt, lays them over a stock UGC background clip that reveals one item per beat, and saves the result to your library (9:16). Costs no credits. Synchronous: the request returns when the deck is built, typically 5 to 20 seconds. Publish it with POST /posts using the deck from GET /content/{id}, or open it in the studio to edit first.

prompt.description: What the list is about. Omit to let the model pick from your brand.

mentionBusiness.description: Make one of the items your brand. Default true.

layout.description: Display style: numbered list (default), tier pyramid, checklist, or countdown to #1.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_ask_me_anything

Writes the question your audience actually asks plus the on-video answer from your brand and prompt, lays them over a stock UGC background clip as an IG-style question sticker, and saves the result to your library (9:16). Costs no credits. Synchronous: the request returns when the deck is built, typically 5 to 20 seconds. Publish it with POST /posts using the deck from GET /content/{id}, or open it in the studio to edit first.

prompt.description: What the question should be about. Omit to let the model pick from your brand.

mentionBusiness.description: Name the brand in the answer. Default true.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_ranking
tools.description: Create a ranking (tier list) video. Writes a tier-list title plus 5 to 7 tiered items (S/A/B/C) from your brand and prompt, finds a stock photo for each item, and saves an image tier-board video to your library (9:16, items reveal one per beat). Costs no credits. Synchronous: the request returns when the deck is built, typically 10 to 40 seconds. Publish it with POST /posts using the deck from GET /content/{id}, or open it in the studio to edit first.

prompt.description: What the ranking is about. Omit to let the model pick from your brand.

mentionBusiness.description: Make one of the items your brand (tier S, revealed last). Default true.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_split_screen
tools.description: Create a split screen video. Writes an on-brand caption from your prompt (or uses the caption you pass), stacks a stock UGC content clip on top of a looping gameplay/satisfying clip, and saves the result to your library (9:16, duration follows the top clip). Costs no credits. Synchronous: the request returns when the deck is built, typically 5 to 15 seconds. Publish it with POST /posts using the deck from GET /content/{id}, or open it in the studio to edit first.

prompt.description: What the caption should be about. Omit to let the model pick from your brand.

caption.description: Use this exact on-video caption instead of generating one.

mentionBusiness.description: Name the brand in the caption. Default true.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_fade_in_video
tools.description: Create a single fade-in video. Writes one bold caption from your brand and prompt, pairs it with a stock photo that fades in, and saves the result to your library (9:16). Pass imageUrl to use your own picture instead. Costs no credits. Synchronous: the request returns when the deck is built, typically 10 to 30 seconds.

prompt.description: What the video is about. Omit to let the model pick from your brand.

imageUrl.description: Hosted image to fade in. A stock photo is found when omitted.

mentionBusiness.description: Name the brand in the copy. Default true.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_create_hook_demo
tools.description: Stitch a hook clip onto your demo. Puts a captioned hook clip in front of your product demo and saves the pair to your library (9:16). Both media URLs must be hosted; upload them with POST /assets first. The on-screen line is written from your brand unless you pass caption. Costs no credits. Synchronous: returns when the deck is built, typically 5 to 30 seconds.

hookVideoUrl.description: Hosted attention-grabbing clip that plays first

demoVideoUrl.description: Hosted product demo that plays after the hook

caption.description: The line burned over the hook. Written from your brand when omitted.

prompt.description: What the caption should be about, when caption is omitted

hookThumb.description: Poster image for the hook clip

mentionBusiness.description: Name the brand in the copy. Default true.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_get_content
tools.description: Get a studio render's status. Polls a piece created by the /content operations or accepted from a generation. status is processing, ready or failed. Video formats carry videoUrl when ready; DECK formats (slideshow, wall of text, green screen, ...) have no flat media until rendered - publishing renders them automatically, or GET /content/{id}/download renders on demand and returns the files. A failed render has already refunded its credits.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.

tools.name: viraloop_download_content
tools.description: Get a content piece's media files. Returns the finished media files (mp4 for video formats, the slide images for carousels) for a content piece. For deck formats (slideshow, wall of text, green screen and the other studio decks) the FIRST call starts the server-side render and returns 409; poll this endpoint until it returns 200 with the files (typically under a minute). Generations must be accepted first (POST /generations/{id}/accept) to get a content id. Fetching files here marks the piece accepted for metered (enterprise) billing, exactly like publishing it does.

workspaceId.description: Workspace to operate in. Defaults to the team's default workspace.
